docs.text:
# API reference

## HTML/CSS Prerequisites

The Grid depends on there being a root level portal div. Give the parent a real width and height. Import tengrids/dist/index.css. Overlay editors mount into #portal.

## Theme

The theme prop styles the grid. textDark, bgCell, accentColor. Dark mode is a dark theme object, not a CSS class.

## freezeColumns

Frozen columns stay in place while the rest of the grid scrolls. Set freezeColumns to a number greater than 0.
